result.question: What was Apple's total net sales in fiscal year 2024?
result.answer: Apple's total net sales in fiscal year 2024 were $391,035 million (approximately $391.0 billion), for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024 [0000320193-24-000123:item-8-p001]. This figure is also confirmed by the XBRL fact reported in the 10-K filing [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2024-09-28] and by the press release accompanying the 10-K [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002]. Of this total, Products net sales were $294,866 million and Services net sales were $96,169 million [0000320193-24-000123:item-8-p001]. Total net sales increased 2% compared to fiscal year 2023's $383,285 million [0000320193-24-000123:item-7-p001].
